prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1020; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. Presenting complaints included headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, which are consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm a concussion. No prior injury to the head or neck is known from the patient's history or available records. The patient completed 23 visits consisting of symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive therapy, and graduated exertion guidance. Care followed a typical course for this injury, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms resolved and functional capacity returned. Billed services correspond to the treatment documented in the chart, with no repeated charges identified. The patient is now released to full activity, with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
